Name: Another Harder Community Center Mod
Author: webxro
Description:
Another mod that works to make finishing the community center harder. It changes mostly everything except the bulletin board because I am almost certain that it is hard enough.

Fully compatible with 1.2.30

All suggestions for balances and improvements are welcomed and will be credited.

Installation :

1. Backup all the files starting with "Bundle" in "/Content/Data/" there should be 7 files.
2. Extract the content of the archive to the main StarDew Valley folder. The one that contains the executable.

Uninstall : 

Restore the backup-ed files to their original location.


For problems with any mods you can find help on [url=https://discord.gg/0lZ1oe3RPoGAnq9D]Discord. [/url]
